title: May 2015 General Election (Beta — Alternative History)
description: Beta scenario based on the May 2015 UK general election. The simulation begins in August 2015 with players entering a newly-formed Parliament. Constituency/election baseline data is now populated, but this scenario remains in active development because budget baselines, factions, and bodies/locals seeding are not yet fully scenario-specific.

initialization.blockedReason: Initialization remains blocked: while 2015-beta constituency/election baseline data is populated, full admin initialization is not yet scenario-safe (election/faction seeding still enforces default-scenario-only paths, and budget/bodies/locals still seed default-scenario baselines).
